counterfactual_missing_items: No evidence of hemorrhagic lesions or ring-enhancing lesions to support AHLE
No documented coronary artery involvement or specific MIS-C diagnostic criteria met beyond systemic inflammation

decisive_items: Multifocal smooth stenosis of both intracranial internal carotid arteries, right middle cerebral artery, and both A2 segments of anterior cerebral arteries
Diffuse narrowing of M2 and M3 segment branches of both middle cerebral arteries
Progressive weakness on the right side of body for 5 days
response.rationale: R1 directly matches the pathognomonic CT angiography findings of multifocal smooth stenosis and diffuse narrowing of cerebral arteries, which are the most specific and complete evidence for cerebral vasculitis. R5 captures the systemic inflammatory syndrome (MIS-C) but misses the definitive vascular imaging findings. Other candidates either describe components (R6, C3) or are unsupported by the imaging (R3, C5).
